company_name: KLN Logistics Group Limited (formerly Kerry Logistics Network)

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR consolidated statement of changes in equity: 'Share-based compensation under share-award scheme' HK$945k (HK$0.9m). Share Award Scheme is the only equity plan; no awards granted in FY2025. Effectively an SBC-zero filer; SBC rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.buyback_note: No ordinary-share buybacks. FY2024 HK$39.7m was trustee purchases for the share award scheme (FY2025 nil). The FY2025 HK$744.5m 'Repurchase of perpetual convertible securities' (book HK$774m, held by an S.F. Holding subsidiary) is a financing item retiring a junior equity-like instrument, not a share buyback; balance is nil at 31-Dec-2025 so nothing remains to deduct.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average 1,802.128m for H1 FY2026 (interim report note 9: 1,802,062k basic + 66k share-award adjustment). Held FLAT: SBC is immaterial and there is no non-SBC issuance in view.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z (Yahoo regularMarketTime, Friday HKEX regular close; 52-week range 5.45-7.45)
inputs.net_debt_note: 30-Jun-2026 interim balance sheet: short-term + current LT bank loans 2,917.653 + long-term bank loans 5,886.453 + overdrafts 14.460 + loans from non-controlling interests 200.853 = 9,019.419 total debt; less cash at bank and in hand 5,959.326 = net debt 3,060.09. Lease liabilities (HK$2,319.8m) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Supplier-finance payables (HK$126m at FY2025) and retirement obligations (HK$42m) left out as immaterial (<HK$0.1/share).
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows; the HKD is pegged to the USD so a USD-like risk-free rate applies. Rf ~4.0% (HK/US 10-yr), ERP 5.5%, beta ~1.05 for a cyclical Asia-centred freight forwarder -> cost of equity ~9.8%. Pre-tax cost of bank debt ~4.5% (FY2025 interest paid 405 on ~9bn floating-rate HIBOR/SOFR loans), after tax ~3.6%. Target weights ~80/20 equity/debt (ex-lease net debt 3.1bn vs market cap ~10.6bn, gross bank debt higher) -> WACC ~8.6%, rounded to 9.0%. Same WACC in every scenario: cyclicality, China/US tariff exposure and controlling-shareholder governance are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not in a rate premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B) leases as operating cost. FY2025 'Payments of lease liabilities' HK$1,060.9m (financing) is principal plus interest: the AR lease-liability reconciliation shows net cash flows of 1,060.9 against a separate HK$97.5m interest accrual, and total lease cash outflow 1,544.3 = 1,060.9 + 483.4 short-term lease expense already inside opex. lease_cost_pct_path ~1.9% of revenue (FY2025 1.88%, H1 FY2026 588.0/29,851 = 1.97%) is deducted inside EBIT. da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 D&A 1,699.3 - RoU depreciation 993.8 = 705.5 = 1.25% of revenue) so the lease is not charged twice. Lease liabilities are excluded from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE inside the flows: non-controlling interests took HK$283.8m of HK$1,699.6m FY2025 profit (16.7%; FY2024 continuing 267.6m), and subsidiaries paid HK$336.8m dividends to NCI. cash_tax_rate_path is therefore a combined leakage driver: 1 - (1 - 30% cash tax) x (1 - 16.7% NCI) = ~41.7%, used as 41%. No NCI deduction in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 core EBITDA 4,326 - leases 1,061 - D&A ex-RoU 705 = EBIT 2,560; less net bank interest ~270 plus associates 46 = ~2,336 pre-tax; x (1 - 0.41) = ~1,378 vs reported attributable 1,410.9 (continuing) - ties within 2%. Recurring cash purchases of minority stakes (FY2025 378m, FY2024 417m) are treated as acquisitions/capital allocation, not charged.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (leases, NCI, matching-asset bridge, SBC-zero). Routing: KLN is an operating company (asset-light freight forwarding ~75% of revenue plus contract logistics/warehousing ~25%), not a financial, REIT or holdco; first valuation of this ticker so no prior model to match. BASE YEAR: FY2025 continuing operations (revenue 56,335.8; core operating profit 2,626.7 per the company's own reconciliation, which excludes interest income, disposal gains and investment-property fair-value changes). Core EBITDA = core OP 2,626.7 + D&A 1,699.3 = 4,326 = 7.68% of revenue. FY2021 (HK$4.58bn KEX Thailand spin-off gain, HK$13.97bn special dividend) and FY2023 (HK$419m discontinued loss) are non-representative and are not used as anchors; FY2021-22 also embed the COVID freight-rate boom, which is why every 3-yr historical CAGR is negative. INTEREST INCOME: the company is net-debt, so interest income (FY2025 135.3) is not deducted in last_fcf by formula; it is in any case already outside the flows because core operating profit excludes it, and cash is netted against debt in the bridge. last_fcf follows the house formula (reported OCF - capex - SBC); on a lease-consistent basis (also deducting lease payments 1,060.9) FY2025 owner FCF was ~HK$1,216m, and after NCI dividends ~HK$880m. GUIDANCE: none quantitative. H1 FY2026 interim (Aug-2026): revenue +10% to 29,851, core operating profit -8% to 1,236 (IL -7%, IFF -7%), core net profit +2%; outlook 'cautiously optimistic', 'IFF market expected to remain challenging but demand should stay resilient', Middle East developments and freight/fuel volatility may affect costs. Base FY2026 = H1 actual plus a flat-to-slightly-better H2 -> revenue ~+7%, core OP margin ~4.2% (FY2025 4.66%, H1 FY2026 4.14%), core EBITDA ~7.0%. SBC: immaterial (HK$0.9m), house and street coincide; band_position null by construction. WORKING CAPITAL: receivables 15.6bn vs payables 10.8bn - growth consumes cash, wc_capture -8% of the revenue change.

equity_bridge.item: Associates and joint venture at book
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR balance sheet (31-Dec-2025). Share of results (46.4m) and associate dividends (138.1m) sit below core operating profit, so the asset is added rather than its income kept in the flows.
FY2025 AR balance sheet, fair value. Dividend income from them is excluded from core OP.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: forward base-case revenue growth (FY2027-30), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: All historical CAGRs are distorted and none is usable as a forward rate. The 3-yr window starts at the FY2022 freight-rate peak (revenue 86.6bn incl. Kerry Express Thailand, later spun off), the equity series is cut by the FY2021 HK$13.97bn special dividend/distribution in specie, and EPS FY2021 carries a HK$4.58bn spin-off gain. Equity 5-yr CAGR (-8.4%) diverges >30% from revenue 5-yr (+1.1%). Selected 4.0% is the base-case medium-term revenue growth: Asia trade growth plus KLN 2.0 share gains, cross-checked to FY2020-25 revenue CAGR of +1.1% through a full freight cycle and H1 FY2026 +10%.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGR is on reported OCF - capex less SBC (HK$0.9m, immaterial), so SBC-adjusted and reported CAGRs are the same; FCF here is pre-lease-payments, consistent across the history. Historical continuing-operations core operating profit was flat-to-down (FY2024 2,725 -> FY2025 2,627 -> H1 FY2026 -8%) while revenue grew - margin compression, not volume, is the live issue.

base.narrative: FY2026 lands near H1 run-rate (revenue +7%, core EBITDA 7.0%); core margin recovers only partly toward the FY2024-25 7.7% as KLN 2.0 automation offsets IFF price competition.

bull.narrative: KLN 2.0 scale-up plus S.F. ecosystem volume (Ezhou, S.F. Airlines GSA) and China+1 IL growth; IL mix and automation lift core EBITDA to ~8.3%.

bear.narrative: Middle East disruption premium unwinds and US tariffs cut Trans-Pacific volume: FY2027 revenue -6%, NVOCC margins compress further, HK IL keeps shrinking.

scenario_narratives.base: KLN keeps growing volume but not margin. FY2026 is built from the H1 interim (revenue +10%, core operating profit -8%) with a flat-to-slightly-better H2: revenue +7%, core EBITDA 7.0% (FY2025 7.7%). Thereafter revenue grows 4% a year - Asia/China+1 trade growth, Southeast Asia IL (+23% segment profit in FY2025) and project/EPC logistics - fading to 3%. Core EBITDA recovers only to 7.4% by FY2030: KLN 2.0 automation and warehouse optimisation are offset by persistent IFF price competition, incomplete fuel pass-through and a structurally weak Hong Kong IL business. Leases ~1.9% of revenue, capex slightly above ex-RoU depreciation, growth consumes working capital (receivables exceed payables).
scenario_narratives.bull: KLN 2.0 works: management's ambition to double scale and become a top-10 global forwarder gains traction through S.F. Holding cross-selling, the Ezhou Airport ground-handling JV, the S.F. Airlines GSA, overseas IL expansion (US, Europe, Australia) and Hainan FTP duty-free logistics. AI-infrastructure freight on the Asia-US lane and China+1 relocation keep the Trans-Pacific NVOCC franchise full. Revenue grows 7% a year for three years, decelerating to 3%; the mix shift toward contract logistics and automation lifts core EBITDA to 8.3% (above the FY2024-25 level), i.e. core operating margin back above 5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The freight cycle turns. The Middle East-driven rate and routing premium of 2026 unwinds, US tariff escalation and inventory digestion cut Trans-Pacific volumes, and revenue falls 6% in FY2027 (FY2023 showed a -45% revenue year is possible after a boom). Forwarders fight for share, NVOCC margins compress further, HK consumption keeps shrinking IL, and S.F.-related-party business proves a mixed blessing. Core EBITDA settles at 6.5% (core operating margin ~3.7%) and growth stalls at 2%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: freight forwarding is deeply cyclical (FY2023 revenue -45% after the FY2021-22 boom), core operating profit is already falling for two consecutive periods, and a live Middle East/tariff shock can cut either way. Base 50% as the H1 FY2026 run-rate extended. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right - KLN 2.0 volume, S.F. synergies and a reversal of a margin trend that has not yet turned.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Unlevered owner-FCF DCF on core (underlying) continuing-operations profit, leases charged as an operating cost (treatment B, lease liabilities excluded from net debt), NCI leakage folded into the cash-tax driver so the flows are attributable-only, associates and FVOCI assets added at book in the bridge. Cyclical business: terminal value capped at 12x terminal FCF, and risk carried in the scenarios and weights rather than in the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Freight-rate cyclicality: IFF is ~75% of revenue and a pass-through business; a down-cycle can cut revenue sharply and compress NVOCC margins
Continuing core margin compression (core OP -4% FY2025, -8% H1 FY2026) despite revenue growth
US tariff policy and Trans-Pacific volume whiplash (KLN is the No.1 Asia-US NVOCC)
Controlling shareholder S.F. Holding: related-party business and financing (perpetual convertibles, GSA), minority-shareholder treatment
NCI leakage (~17% of profit) and recurring cash buyouts of minorities (HK$378-417m/yr) that the model treats as capital allocation
Hong Kong IL structural decline and China consumption weakness
Floating-rate bank debt (HK$8.8bn, 38% due within one year) and unhedged multi-currency exposure
